reasoning_content: Step 1 has been saved, and it's redirecting to step 2. I'll fetch step 2 and send the OIDC configuration. According to the compose comments (the reliable source), the correct credentials are client_id `nebu-gateway` / secret `nebu-dev-secret`, with audience being `nebu-gateway`. I'll check what the form expects — it requires the audience field. The guide says client ID `nebu-admin` / secret `nebu-admin-secret`, but that client doesn't exist in dex (only `nebu-gateway` exists). This is an old/inaccurate detail in the guide, so I'll go with the actual dex configuration.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap -o step2.html
grep -o 'id="bootstrap-step-[0-9]"' step2.html
grep -o 'name="_csrf_token" value="[^"]*"' step2.html | head -1
grep -o 'name="oidc_[a-z_]*"' step2.html | sort -u
